name: apply_dossier_enrichment
description: Takes the structured output of the `enrich_dossier` agent and persists it: overwrites the candidate's dossier file with the enriched markdown, updates the candidate row with the refined score + next-action, and writes a short audit note. Idempotent — re-running with the same payload is safe. Never invoked directly by the founder; it's the second half of the `enrich_candidate` workflow.
